Easy.Ink Affiliate Program Description

Brand Introduction:

Welcome to Easy.Ink, the leader in innovative and high-quality temporary tattoos. At Easy.Ink, we are committed to providing our customers with the freedom to express themselves through beautiful, realistic temporary tattoos that last up to two weeks. Our dedication to creativity, safety, and quality has made us a trusted name in the temporary tattoo industry.

Product Description:

Easy.Ink offers a diverse range of temporary tattoo products that cater to various styles and preferences. Our product line includes:

  • Temporary Tattoos: High-quality, long-lasting designs that mimic the appearance of real tattoos. Each tattoo is easy to apply and stays vibrant for up to two weeks.
  • Tattoo Kits: Complete kits that include everything you need to create stunning temporary tattoos at home, perfect for both beginners and experienced artists.
  • Custom Designs: Personalized tattoo options that allow you to create unique, one-of-a-kind designs tailored to your specific tastes.
  • Aftercare Products: Specially formulated products to maintain the vibrancy and longevity of your temporary tattoos.

Unique Selling Point (USP):

What sets Easy.Ink apart is our commitment to providing a unique and premium temporary tattoo experience. Our products are:

  • Realistic and Long-Lasting: Designed to look like real tattoos, our temporary tattoos maintain their color and detail for up to two weeks.
  • Skin-Safe: Made with non-toxic, skin-friendly ingredients that are safe for all skin types.
  • Easy to Apply and Remove: Simple application process with no mess, and easy removal without any residue.
  • Wide Range of Designs: From intricate patterns to bold statements, our extensive catalog ensures there’s a design for everyone.
  • Customizable: Create your own custom designs to suit your personal style or special occasions.

Payment Terms:

Easy.Ink offers a competitive and straightforward commission structure for our affiliates:

  • Commission Rate: Earn an attractive percentage on every sale made through your unique affiliate link.
  • Payment Schedule: Commissions are paid monthly, with a minimum payout threshold to ensure timely and reliable payments.
  • Payment Methods: Multiple payment options are available, including bank transfer, PayPal, and other popular methods.

Other Information:

  • Marketing Support: Affiliates are required to create their own promotional videos featuring Easy.Ink products. We suggest purchasing our product to ensure authenticity and quality in your content. As a special incentive, we will fully refund the cost of the product once you have submitted a video showcasing Easy.Ink. This program is exclusive to USA promoters only.
  • Exclusive Offers: Benefit from special promotions and discounts exclusive to our affiliates, providing more opportunities to increase your earnings.
  • Affiliate Dashboard: Our user-friendly affiliate dashboard allows you to track your performance, sales, and commissions in real-time.
  • 24/7 Support: Our dedicated affiliate support team is always available to assist you with any questions or concerns.

Join the Easy.Ink affiliate program today and start earning by promoting top-tier temporary tattoos that offer the perfect blend of style and convenience. Together, we can inspire creativity and self-expression with our stunning, long-lasting designs.
